name: 2 Samuel
title: 2 Samuel — David’s Throne and David’s Sin
tagline: Covenant promise and the wages of royal sin.
purpose: Establish the Davidic covenant and show sin’s fallout even in the beloved king.
christ: Son of David; everlasting throne (2 Sam 7 → Luke 1:32–33).
spirit: The God who convicts through Nathan still restores the broken king.
jesus_in_this_book: Son of David; everlasting throne (2 Sam 7 → Luke 1:32–33).
how_to_read: Hold covenant promise and moral realism together.
watchman_charge: When the prophet points, repent. Do not manage the image.
